import sys
from collections import defaultdict

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    T = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    for _ in range(T):

        ptr += 1
        A = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr+N]))
        ptr += N

        freq = defaultdict(int)
        for num in A:
            freq[num] += 1

        duplicates = sum(v - 1 for v in freq.values() if v > 1)
        print(duplicates)

solve()
